blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. Sale and lease listings.

Retail space for sale and lease in Langley: storefronts, retail strata units and retail buildings listed on the MLS®. Space for lease is included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.

items.t: The City of Langley’s Official Community Plan names neighbourhood corner commercial sites at 203 Street by Portage Park, 200 Street and 50 Avenue, 200 Street and 56 Avenue, and 208 Street and 48 Avenue. ([City of Langley Official Community Plan](https://www.langleycity.ca/media/file/ocp-official-community-plan-bylaw-r), read November 20, 2026)

Aldergrove, on the Township’s eastern edge, has shops as well as the Gloucester Industrial Park. ([Township of Langley, Aldergrove](https://www.tol.ca/en/the-township/aldergrove.aspx), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: In the second quarter of 2026, 10 of the 20 commercial sales in Langley were retail & other properties, against 82 across the Lower Mainland.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
Township of Langley and City of Langley zones that allow retail uses
Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.

faq.a: 10 in the second quarter of 2026, out of 20 commercial sales in Langley (GVR Commercial Edge).
